1000-years-later-even-my-weakest-followe:
Zhou Mu finds himself remaining in a single-player VR game despite having decided to quit after platinum-ing the entire game. However, he realizes that the world has completely changed. Realizing life in the game is better, he continues on with his in-game name, William Kane.
“Why is the world united under my name? And what’s with the religion that honors me as their god? The royals are claiming to be my descendants? Was there ever such a function in the game? What have they done for the past 1000 years when I was gone?”
Zhou Mu was completely lost.
“Are you calling me a traitor? Aren’t you guys the ones who have been doing evil deeds in my name? Behold, for you shall witness this lost forbidden spell!”

Reed Adeleheights Roton, the false final boss of the game.

The one who due to his inferiority complex led to his own doom.
The one who turned a cute innocent girl into the monstrous First Disaster codenamed Cosmo.
“If I was the Villain then I would have raised her a little better.”
And thus God granted his wish and now he was the false final Villain Reed Adeleheights Roton, the creator of the Seven Disasters.
How different would the world turn out to be now?
after-divorce-i-inherited-the-games-fort:

From then on, life underwent earth shattering changes!
Money, reputation, status, commercial empire.
Ex-wife knelt down and begged for remarriage? Sorry, when I was in trouble, you left me. Now that I'm better, you want to come and enjoy the glory and wealth?！
you do not deserve!
after-divorcing-she-shocked-the-world:
Top Special Agent, Wu Mei, was murdered in a conspiracy. When she opened her eyes again, she found herself transmigrated into the body of the gorgeous, abandoned wife of a handsome, wealthy man and… She was sleeping with him!
The handsome man placed the divorce papers in front of her and said, “Let’s get a divorce. I’ll give you one hundred million.”
Father: “If you don’t get the money from President Li, your mother will pay with her life!”
Stepmother: “Quickly get a divorce and let your younger sister take your place!”
A sly smile crept up Wu Mei’s face. She agreed, “Sure. But... you’ll have to raise the stakes.”
After her divorce, Wu Mei became stronger and stronger. She dealt with her stepmother and punished scumbags. She was awesome!
Gradually, her true identity was revealed – A medical genius, hacker, businesswoman… Her existence shook the world!
All the big shots knelt before her. “Whoever messes with her, messes with us!”
Then, at a cocktail party, someone saw…
The almighty Mr. Li clinging onto Wu Mei’s waist, his eyes red as he begged, “Let’s get married again. I’ll even give you my life.”
Just like before, Wu Mei smiled slyly and said, “You’ll have to raise the stakes.”
apostle-of-the-gods:
The one single goal in life of the Strongest Old Sage is to subjugate the Demon King. In an epic final battle, both of them met their mutual destruction at each other’s hands.
However, the Demon King was not completely destroyed!
In order to destroy the Demon King once and for all; post-death, the Old Sage trains in the World of Gods and reincarnates as the Apostle of the Gods, Will.
In the reincarnated future, the Old Sage had become a legend and his former disciples hold the supreme authority in the world. The disciples had created an organization to oppose the Demon King and an academy to nurture the new generation of Heroes.
Thus the Apostle of the Gods, Will (8 year old), enrols into that Academy of Heroes.
This is the story of a boy on a mission to save the world through epic battles while enjoying Academy life.
back-to-the-80s-reclaiming-my-name-my-fa:
In her last life, Song Yao was dumped in a village slum.
The girl who replaced her grew up in luxury, beloved by the parents who should have been Song Yao's.
Cast aside by her biological parents and never truly accepted by her adoptive family, Song Yao spent her life desperately trying to please everyone—only to be betrayed in the end and drowned by the very “heiress” who stole her identity.
When she opened her eyes again, she had returned to the night she was being forced into marriage.
Staring at her greedy adoptive mother and the sleazy old widower, Song Yao merely smiled.
In this life, she would rewrite her own fate.
The same schemes that once destroyed her life would now be turned against her enemies.
On the very night of the forced marriage, she flipped the situation entirely—sending her adoptive mother in her place into the bridal chamber. Meanwhile, Song Yao kept the key token that would lead her back to her true family, calmly waiting for her biological parents to arrive.
Soon after, the Shen Family of Beijing welcomed back their true heiress.
None of them realized that beneath her quiet composure, Song Yao had already begun laying her plans.…
born-to-be-a-secretary:
Kim Heewon, an eloquent and quick-witted chief secretary. It’s already been six years since he became the right-hand man of Executive Director Kwon Young-jae, who’s notorious for being extremely difficult to work with.
People often ask him how he manages such a grueling job. And every time, Kim Heewon simply answers that turns out, being a secretary was his true calling.
“Do you know how old Secretary Kim is?”
“……”
“You’re telling me a thirty-one-year-old man just presented as an omega? And I’m supposed to believe that?”
But then he did present as an omega. Naturally, Kwon Young-jae, who suffers from a serious omega-related neurosis, was furious.
“Sir, thank you for everything until now.”
“I didn’t know you were this irresponsible.”
“You, more than anyone, should know it’s impossible for us to keep working together.”
Heewon resigned according to proper procedures and fully embraced the sweet life of unemployment. Meanwhile, Kwon Young-jae’s daily life fell apart without Secretary Kim.
Eventually, the proud Executive Director Kwon begins his desperate persuasion.…
bride-of-retribution-aloof-billionaires-:

He pressed her under him, a deep and unfathomable smile in his eyes, “The Miller Family lost me a bride, shouldn't they compensate me with another one? Mrs. Hallow, I've never made such a bad deal in my life.”

divine-glitch-i-regressed-with-endgame-k:
They stole his future. Now, he’s rewriting reality.
Ryan was at the top—champion of the world’s biggest VRMMO, but one wish changed everything.
“I wish I could start over.”
The Orb of Wishes granted it. Literally. Time snapped backward. The world unraveled. And Ryan woke up years in the past, holding his younger sisters close in a rotting apartment, broke and desperate.
This time, he’s not starting from scratch.
He remembers it all. Every hidden boss. Every bugged quest. Every game-breaking secret. While the world waits for the launch of Kingdom Forge, Ryan prepares to tear through it like a storm.
But when he logs in, something glitches.
His old character is locked. His class is reset. His power? Supposedly gone.
Then the system flashes something strange:
[Access Granted: Legacy Bank Synced]
[Warning: You were never meant to exist.]
Ryan grins. He doesn’t need a strong class. He doesn’t need fair odds. He has what nobody else does—endgame knowledge in a beginner’s world, and an account holding gear, gold, and exploits that broke the game once before.
He’s done being a pawn.
This time, he’ll become the glitch the system can’t contain.

historys-strongest-son-in-law-living-wit:
Left disfigured after an unfortunate accident, Shen Lang, a doctor, has become so ugly that no one dares to look at him. This makes him decide to become a noble spirit instead and save lives along war-torn borders. He lives a lonely life, remaining single until a bomb takes his life.

He transmigrates to another world and in this life, he has the body of an absolutely handsome man. However, the said owner of this body is a live-in son-in-law, one who was chased out for being a useless moron, of a wealthy merchant.
In order to fulfill his goal of living an extremely relaxed life, Shen Lang finds his way to become the new son-in-law of the ‘Goddess’ of the much more influential Palace of the Earl. i-can-traverse-multiple-worlds:
In the Great Cosmic Era, Martial Arts no longer exist, and the path of the Immortal Dao is severed. In their place are giant ships and grand cannons, and genetic leaps.
Wang Xiao was born in this era and inherited his family's Martial Arts Hall.
Under his diligent management, the Martial Arts Hall finally neared bankruptcy.
Fortunately, at this moment, a Book of Space-Time appeared in his mind.
With the Book of Space-Time, Wang Xiao can traverse the myriad heavens, Analyze All Things, and experience the magnificent eras of Martial Arts and the worlds of the Immortal Dao.

i-level-up-while-i-sleep:
Hasib is an ordinary and powerless student who has spent most of his life being ignored, mocked, and bullied. He has no talent, but he still dreams of becoming a powerful Warrior.
Everything changes during a school trip to a mysterious museum.
Among countless ancient artifacts, Hasib discovers a strange mirror that seems to react to his presence. He doesn't know why but that night, after falling asleep, he awakens in a world that should not exist.
A mysterious System appears before him.
[Do you want to become a strong Warrior?]
[Yes or No]
Every time Hasib sleeps, he enters a different type of training a Domain filled with dangerous enemies, impossible challenges, and forgotten warriors. If he survives, he gains abilities, attributes, skills, and rewards that remain with him after waking.
For the first time, the weakest boy in his class has a way to become stronger.
But the System is hiding something.
The strange mirror, the ancient swords, and the legendary warrior who disappeared seven hundred years ago are all connected to Hasib in ways he cannot understand.
As his strength grows, forgotten enemies begin to awaken.…
i-will-fulfill-the-role-of-the-villain:
The protagonist of a war fantasy novel, Theo, competes with his rival and antagonist, Luke, for the position of Supreme Commander.
Having been reincarnated into Luke’s role, he struggles to fulfill his duties as the villain.
“It seems like principles as a soldier, the duties I should uphold, don’t matter to you at all.”
Even if misunderstood by Theo, Luke silently remained faithful to his role as the antagonist.
After completing all his duties, Luke successfully gave Theo his happy ending, cast aside his military uniform, and retired from the army.
Now, Luke planned to create his own future story without interference from anyone.
That was the plan, at least…
“Why go this far? I’m no longer a soldier, and if you really think about it, we were never on good terms anyway.”
To make matters worse, not only had he unexpectedly reunited with Theo, but now, Theo was persistently and seriously pressing him in a way he hadn’t imagined.
“I want to know you better.”
It was a completely incomprehensible statement, and it wasn’t even an appropriate answer to the question.
The protagonist came to the antagonist and suddenly asked for help, simply because they wanted to know him better?
immortal-in-horror-game-she-is-the-fortu:
She is the true daughter of a prestigious family in the Federation, who was lost outside and grew up in a garbage heap, and is also a waste with only F-level spiritual power.

Zarek wasted his youth chasing pleasures, avoiding work, and laughing at others’ dreams.
When death finally came, so did regret.
But fate wasn’t done mocking him yet.
A god declared him a “good-for-nothing extra” and gave his destined powers to another soul—a perfect copy of him who did everything right.
Then, without warning, Zarek was thrown into a strange new world…
and immediately chased by an angry mob.
Cornered and desperate, he jumped into an infamous Sacrificial Dungeon—a place where no one comes out alive.
That should’ve been his end.
Instead, it became his beginning.
[Class Awakened: Infinite Origin Summoner]
Grade: Ultimate
Potential: Infinite]
For the first time in his life, Zarek had power—
and the ability to summon an endless army of monsters that grew stronger with him.
But his awakening didn’t go unnoticed.
The Dungeon Supervisors, hidden beings who control fate itself, have taken an interest in him.
Too bad.
Zarek’s done playing by the rules of gods, heroes, and “main characters.”
He’ll fight, lie, and laugh his way to the top—because this time, the worthless extra refuses to die forgotten.
“I don’t need destiny. I’ll build my own.”
infinite-snake-evolution-but-my-system-i:
Dying is mostly just embarrassing. Barry didn’t go down in a blaze of glory; he tripped over a stray cat, smacked his chin on a fire hydrant, and bit his own tongue off in front of a crowd of teenagers.
When he wakes up in a fantasy world, he isn’t a legendary hero or a powerful mage. He’s a bright blue, six-inch “Azure Runt”—a pathetic garden snake at the very bottom of the local food chain. To make matters worse, his own siblings want to turn him into a afternoon snack, and his “System” is a Total menace.But Barry was a grocery store assistant manager for five years. He has dealt with angry customers, crazy corporate bosses, and coupon Karens. A few cannibal reptiles aren't going to break him.
Equipped with a completely broken ability to steal the biological codes of anything he bites, Barry decides to reject the epic dragon paths and stick strictly to what he knows best: corporate theft, cutting corners, and scamming his way to the top of the monster ecosystem.Geniuses train for decades to reach the peak of cultivation? A few nights before her wedding, Lauren sought a way to break her fourth engagement. Known for her bad reputation as the rebel princess, she was the only lady who had the guts to step foot on the Everston mansion, the house of a notorious warlord, in the middle of the night.

legacy-of-a-benevolent-lord:
My name is Riveron. This is my story.
Concubine-born, scorned by my own blood, probably forgotten by name.
In my last life, I clawed through a slum. In this one, I claw through a noble cage.
Two different lives. Same suffering.
I was born into a MARTIAL WORLD, where emperors rule with iron fists, where blades split mountains, and words of the weak mean nothing.
But none of that mattered to me.
I only wanted one thing: ESCAPE. Escape this house.
And so I chose the quickest path: Imperial Scholar.
Rise through merit. LEARN, climb, climb, and climb.
It was a good plan. It should have worked. But I was blind to a much bigger plan brewing behind the curtains.
The day I left home, I thought I’d reach the capital. Finally, to walk the path of the sages.
Instead, I was AMBUSHED. THEY BROKE ME.
Limbs shattered. Hope erased. Pride reduced to screams.
I survived only by leaping into the sinkhole beneath the lake.
And somehow… I SURVIVED. An angel saved me. But that wasn’t the only miracle.
I awakened a system.
For every gift I give, I can trigger a critical return.

Fate's gift, maybe? But Fate will regret it.…

Catching arrows, running up walls, crushing boulders and bending metal, these are but petty parlour tricks in the eyes of martial artists. But where can a genuine martial artist stand in an era where martial artists are nothing more than a myth?
Wang Yu, the most peerless martial prodigy the world has ever seen, elopes with his wife to escape an arranged marriage that was set for him as a child.
